summary: Pole L-4 lookout completed in 1931 on 72 Peak at the Montana-Idaho line; gone by 1950, with sources giving abandoned, destroyed or removed.

facts.design: 30-foot pole L-4 tower with a porch around the cab
facts.status_note: Sources date its end to 1950 but differ on how (abandoned, destroyed or removed); no source describes remains

events.note: Completed 1931 on 72 Peak at the Montana-Idaho state line; reached by auto over the Jacks Gulch road south of Heron
Montana listing marks it 'Removed'; no date given

evidence.supports: Lookout on 72 Peak completed in 1931 on the Montana-Idaho state line
evidence.quote: The new lookout at 72 peak on the Montana-Idaho state line has been completed.

evidence.supports: Porch entirely around the cab, 30-foot tower, insulated against lightning
evidence.quote: with porch entirely around it, built on a 30 foot tower, and heavily insulated against lightning.

evidence.supports: Reached by car over the Jacks Gulch road, south of Heron
evidence.quote: It can be reached by auto over the Jacks gulch road, south of Heron.

evidence.supports: Montana listing marks it Removed, with no date
Idaho listing places it in the Coeur d’Alene National Forest
A first visit went to the wrong location; a return trip found the correct site
evidence.quote: Our first visit to Divide was not, infact, to the correct location

evidence.supports: A return trip found the correct site
evidence.quote: So we made a return trip and sure enough, found the correct site.

evidence.supports: Forest Fire Lookout Association index lists the tower as gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says abandoned 1950; Idaho Fire Lookouts says destroyed 1950; a Montana listing marks it Removed with no date. The story reports all three.
Montana listings and firelookout.com name the Kootenai National Forest; Idaho Fire Lookouts names the Coeur d'Alene National Forest. The record keeps Kootenai.

notes_for_editor: Coordinates conflict: the record uses the FFLA point 47.96641, -116.02442; firelookout.com gives 47.97274, -116.03039. Not resolved; treat the point as approximate. Staffing left out: Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history. Idaho Fire Lookouts has Weber family photos (1937, 1939, 1971) of the site, not added here because the page gives no image URLs in the cache. No source describes remains or public access today.
